answer: What survives to the ivory is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pigment of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
